class.name: SteamServerDetails
class.brief_description: Detached metadata and measured ping from a selected Steam server.

method.name: get_listing
method.description: Current Steam observation of the selected server and address. Gameplay still verifies the connection certificate.

method.name: get_ping_ms
method.description: Measured ping in milliseconds, or -1 for an empty snapshot.

method.name: get_tags
method.description: Bounded tags copied from Steam server metadata.
